signals.name: Account delivery pause, Feb 27 - Mar 12 2026 (zero delivery 14 days)
signals.mechanism: No delivery for 14 days: 2026-02-27..03-04 return rows with spend=0 and impressions=0, 2026-03-05..03-12 return no rows at all. 2026-03-02 records 2 purchases against $0 spend (lagged attribution). Excluded from all baselines (engine/baseline.py EXCLUDE_DATES); post-resume days carry learning-phase reset risk.
signals.machine_check: python -c "import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_csv('data/meta/account_daily.csv',parse_dates=['date_start']); z=df[df.spend==0].date_start.dt.date.tolist(); print(z)" -> exactly 2026-02-27..2026-03-04; verify_pull reports 2026-03-05..12 as the missing-day gap

signals.name: Checkout-event level shift, May 24 2026 (rate x~6.5 overnight)
signals.mechanism: checkouts_initiated/inline_link_clicks steps from a ~0.05 monthly median (Feb-May 23) to ~0.35 on exactly 2026-05-24 (47 -> 287 checkouts day-over-day on similar click volume) and persists. Consistent with an event-definition or tracking change, not gradual demand movement. Any checkout_rate comparison spanning this date is invalid without segmenting; the 2026-06-25 checkout-entry drop (backtest incident jun25-checkout-entry-drop) is measured against POST-shift levels.
signals.machine_check: python -c "import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_csv('data/meta/account_daily.csv',parse_dates=['date_start']); r=df.set_index(df.date_start.dt.date); r['rate']=r.checkouts_initiated/r.inline_link_clicks; import datetime as dt; print(r.loc[dt.date(2026,5,23),'rate'], r.loc[dt.date(2026,5,24),'rate'])" -> ~0.08 vs ~0.40

signals.name: US daylight saving time begins (spring forward), Mar 8 2026
signals.mechanism: Clocks advance 02:00 local; population-level sleep disruption and a one-hour shift of daily-routine attention windows vs ad-delivery pacing for several days. Statutory date (Energy Policy Act of 2005): second Sunday in March. NOTE: falls inside the account delivery pause (2026-02-27..03-12), so it is unobservable in this account's history. Correlation only, coefficient unknown.

rules._comment: Recurring signals, expanded to per-date flags at query time by engine/rules.py. Account-specific response coefficients (median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days, engine/baseline.py baselines) are computed by `python -m engine.rules` when a rule has >= 4 occurrences inside the data window; otherwise coefficient stays null and the rule is prior-only (anti-horoscope rule).

payday_1st.name: Payday: 1st of month
payday_1st.mechanism: Salary/benefits liquidity spike around the 1st; plausible CVR/demand lift.

coefficients.method: median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days

payday_15th.name: Payday: 15th of month
payday_15th.mechanism: Semi-monthly payroll liquidity spike; plausible CVR/demand lift.

coefficients.method: median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days

month_end.name: Month end (last calendar day)
month_end.mechanism: Pre-payday liquidity trough + advertiser-side monthly budget exhaustion/reset effects on auction (also plausibly EXTERNAL_AUCTION via competitor budget cycling).

coefficients.method: median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days

snap_window.name: SNAP issuance window (days 1-10, US aggregate approximation)
snap_window.mechanism: SNAP benefits issue on state-staggered schedules concentrated early in the month; aggregate US liquidity gradient across the month. APPROXIMATION: several states stagger through day 20+; state-level precision requires audience-geo data we do not have.

coefficients.method: median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days

federal_holiday.name: US federal holiday (class)
federal_holiday.mechanism: Routine/attention displacement; retail demand may rise or fall by holiday type. CLASS COEFFICIENT ONLY: pooling Thanksgiving with MLK Day is heterogeneous — treat the pooled coefficient as a weak prior, individual holidays have n=1 each.
federal_holiday.machine_check: statutory dates: 4th Thu Nov 2025=11-27, Dec 25, Jan 1, 3rd Mon Jan 2026=01-19, 3rd Mon Feb=02-16, last Mon May=05-25, Jun 19

coefficients.method: median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days

dst_transition.name: DST transition day (class)
dst_transition.mechanism: See ext-dst-2026-03-08. Only occurrence in-window falls inside the delivery pause -> unobservable; coefficient permanently null until more history accrues.

coefficients.method: median day-of-week-adjusted log residual on flagged days
